stops.title: Where Timothy is
stops.text: The leading city of Asia, where Paul had taught for about three years and where Timothy is told to stay.

stops.title: Where Paul is going
stops.text: The Roman province across the Aegean, home to Philippi and Thessalonica. The letter says only that Paul is on his way there.
